Only the two required test files were created; the deleted files were pre-existing worktree state I left untouched, as instructed.

**Summary**

- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/AnnotationUtilsAgentTest.java` — 23 tests covering `equals` (null handling, identity, equal/unequal member values, different annotation types, zero-member annotations), `hashCode` (parity with the real JDK proxy's `hashCode()`, consistency for equal annotations, zero for no members), `isValidAnnotationMemberType` (primitives, `String`/`Class`/enum/annotation types, single- vs multi-dimensional arrays, invalid types, `null`), `toString` (format, member content, equality/inequality across equivalent/differing annotations), and the deprecated public constructor. Uses self-declared nested annotation types and annotated inner classes as fixtures rather than any shared test helper.
- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/AbstractReflectionAgentTest.java` — 9 tests covering the two public static methods: `getForceAccessible()` (property absent/true/false/case-insensitive/invalid-string, saving and restoring the system property around each test) and `setAccessible(boolean, AccessibleObject)` (null object, force-true making a private field accessible, force-false leaving it inaccessible, and the already-accessible short-circuit that ignores the force flag).

Verified with `mvn test -Dtest=AnnotationUtilsAgentTest,AbstractReflectionAgentTest`: all 32 tests pass, no other files modified.
